claim.title: Historical mangrove canopy extent of AOI v1 in the 2020 dry season
claim.extent_explanation: The method states an extent interval only for a SUPPORTED outcome, and this outcome is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
claim.public_statement: BCCS ran a pre-registered measurement of the 2020 mangrove canopy extent of a 1,937 ha research area in Cần Giờ from 24 Sentinel-2 scenes (16 admitted) and 19 Sentinel-1 acquisitions, with every input frozen and every step replayable offline. The result was not robust to the pre-registered threshold brackets, so the method returned INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE and no extent is claimed.

decision_steps.rule: Each group covers at least 99.00 % of the AOI and has valid observations for at least 90.00 %
Both evidence groups and the external reference are present
Temporal rules: every acquisition inside the epoch; the reference period contains the epoch
Primary decision: groups within 10.00 % of each other, reference within 10.00 % of each
Robustness: the decision is the same with each threshold moved to either end of its pre-registered bracket
decision_steps.detail: primary SUPPORTED, mvi_low SUPPORTED, mvi_high CONFLICTING, vh_low SUPPORTED, vh_high CONFLICTING

decision_steps.rule: A SUPPORTED outcome states an extent interval
decision_steps.detail: No interval: the outcome is not SUPPORTED

inner_buffer.rule: IC-14: the AOI mask of each grid eroded by one pixel

tide.rule: IC-15: the quarter of acquisitions with the highest predicted tide removed from each group

open_questions: OD-7 (OPEN): Next step after the threshold-sensitive C-01 result
A. Accept INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE as the C-01 result for the 2020 epoch and keep it unchanged.

B. Commission an independent calibration of the MVI and VH thresholds for Can Gio (data not used in this result), pre-register a method d001-c01-0.2 from it, and evaluate it as a new, separately versioned measurement.
C. Treat the bracket widths themselves as the open question for external review (Gate 7) before any new version.

withheld.field: 6 map layers of the evidence groups and the reference
withheld.reason: A class map of an evidence group shows that group's extent. The method refused to state an extent, and the programme does not publish group-level extent values for a refused result. Authorised reviewers can inspect the map in the operator workspace. The layers: Optical group: canopy class at the primary threshold; Optical group: valid observations per pixel; Radar group: canopy class at the primary threshold; Radar group: median VH backscatter; Radar group: valid observations per pixel; Reference: Global Mangrove Watch v3.0, 2020.
It carries the group values. Its SHA-256 is shown so that a reviewer given access can confirm they hold the same bytes.

programme.one_sentence: BCCS gives the people who pay for, regulate or rely on coastal ecosystem outcomes a record of what the satellite evidence actually supports. Each record can be re-run from stored data, states its uncertainty, and refuses when the evidence is insufficient.
approach: The measurement method, thresholds and area are pre-registered and hashed before any result is computed.
Two sensor groups are used: Sentinel-2 optical and Sentinel-1 radar.
An external reference is used: Global Mangrove Watch.
Every request to a data source leaves a receipt, and every record replays offline from stored bytes.
The outcome may be SUPPORTED with an interval, CONFLICTING or INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE. Refusing to conclude is a designed result, not a failure.
independence_limits: Optical imagery, radar and the reference map are all satellite remote sensing. They are one tier of evidence, not three independent lines.

All three use the same area polygon and pixel rule. The optical and radar groups also share the evaluation grid, the epoch and the programme's processing code, so a shared error would move them together.
Tidal state is the main correlated failure mode. It is addressed by compositing over many dates and by a tide sensitivity.
The reference is a published map, not ground truth. Part of its lineage is optical.
Radar detects any woody canopy and does not identify species. Mangrove attribution rests on the optical group and the reference.
not_claimed: No carbon tonnes, credits, biodiversity or ecosystem-health scores.
No statement about the present-day condition of any site.
No customer, partner, pilot host, revenue or award.
No independent scientific validation and no technology readiness level.
future: Annual dry-season extent records for 2020–2026 at Cần Giờ.
A change claim (C-02) between epochs, pre-registered before it is evaluated.

Independent validation in the field and against very-high-resolution imagery, with external methodology review.
Attestation of record hashes on Base. This is tamper-evident timestamping of records; it is not a token, a credit or a proof that a record is true.
